t: You're looking at the British Museum in Bloomsbury, a public museum of human history, art and culture. Its collection of eight million artefacts is the largest in the world. Established in 1753, it was the world's first public national museum. It exists because Sir Hans Sloane, a physician and collector, left his collection to the nation. The main block and façade you see were designed by Sir Robert Smirke, one of the leaders of Greek Revival architecture. In 2025 it welcomed more than six million visitors, making it the second most visited attraction in the United Kingdom.
